title: Lyapunov Functions for Three-Dimensional Acoustic PML Systems
statement: For the three-dimensional acoustic perfectly matched layer system with spatially varying damping coefficients, construct a Lyapunov function that is nonincreasing and uniformly controls the acoustic energy; in particular, control the terms created by spatial variation of the damping.
